title: Error Correction in Trained TTT Layers
abstract: arXiv:2610.16268v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Test-time-training (TTT) layers update fast-weight memory while processing an input sequence. A gradient-based update, however, does not by itself establish how the memory revises an existing association. We study the structure and empirical role of prediction-derived updates in released TTT implementations. For dot-product objectives, we characterize the absence of a prediction-error residual and establish conditions under which inner-loop ascent and descent are equivalent after reparameterization. For the LayerNorm-based squared-error objective used by TTT-Linear and TTT-MLP, we derive the inner gradient and identify a prediction-derived component that cancels at the released initialization in the zero-epsilon limit. We then measure the full normalized prediction's contribution on three trained checkpoints. Removing this contribution while retaining the LayerNorm Jacobian gives a mean gradient norm ratio of 0.25 to 0.32 acros

translated_title: 已训练TTT层中的误差修正
translated_abstract: 测试时训练（TTT）层在处理输入序列的同时更新快权重记忆。然而，基于梯度的更新本身并不能说明记忆如何修订已有的关联。我们研究了已发布的TTT实现中由预测衍生出的更新的结构与经验作用。对于点积目标，我们刻画了预测误差残差的缺失，并建立了重参数化后内循环上升与下降等价的条件。对于TTT-Linear和TTT-MLP所使用的基于LayerNorm的平方误差目标，我们推导了内循环梯度，并识别出一个预测衍生分量，该分量在零ε极限下于发布的初始化处会相互抵消。随后，我们在三个已训练的检查点上测量了完整归一化预测的贡献。在保留LayerNorm雅可比矩阵的同时移除该贡献，得到的平均梯度范数比值为0.25至0.32。
tldr: 该研究剖析了TTT层的梯度更新机制，证明点积目标下不存在预测误差残差、LayerNorm目标下的预测衍生分量在发布初始化处会相互抵消，并通过实验量化了归一化预测对已训练检查点上梯度更新的实际贡献。
en_tdlr: This work dissects the gradient update mechanisms of TTT layers, showing that dot-product objectives lack a prediction-error residual and the prediction-derived component under the LayerNorm objective cancels at the released initialization, while empirically quantifying the normalized prediction's contribution to gradient updates on trained checkpoints.
